definitions.explanation: Having or showing an open, friendly, and uninhibited personality.
Describing a space that feels open and unconfined.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{開放的|かいほうてき}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧⟦{仲良|なかよ}く→仲良い：29434_nakayoi⟧⟦なれる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: She has an outgoing personality and can get along with anyone.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{開放的|かいほうてき}な⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This company has an open atmosphere.

examples.japanese: {開放的|かいほうてき}な⟦{社風|しゃふう}→社風：29429_shafuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}える→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to the open company culture, even young employees can freely voice their opinions.

examples.japanese: {開放的|かいほうてき}な⟦{空間|くうかん}→空間：13754_kuukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to work in an open, spacious environment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天井|てんじょう}→天井：05008_tenjou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}くて→高い：00500_takai⟧{開放的|かいほうてき}な⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a café with high ceilings that feels open and airy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧{開放的|かいほうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感|かん}じられる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to the large windows, the room feels very open and spacious.

notes:
FORMS:
- Adverbial: {開放的|かいほうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (openly)
- Noun: ⟦{開放|かいほう}→開放：00445_kaihou⟧ (opening, liberalization)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {開放的|かいほうてき}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ (outgoing personality)
- {開放的|かいほうてき}な⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧ (open atmosphere)
- {開放的|かいほうてき}な⟦{空間|くうかん}→空間：13754_kuukan⟧ (open space)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {開放的|かいほうてき} ↔ ⟦{閉鎖的|へいさてき}→閉鎖的：06710_heisateki⟧ (closed, exclusive)
- For personality: {開放的|かいほうてき} (outgoing) vs ⟦{内向的|ないこうてき}→内向的：08458_naikouteki⟧ (introverted)

NUANCE: When describing people, it suggests friendliness and approachability. When describing spaces or organizations, it implies transparency and accessibility.
